services.desc: Build sailing confidence and independence on the water in a supportive, empowering environment. Open to all experience levels, this sailing program teaches the fundamentals or helps refine existing skills. Led by certified female instructors, small class sizes ensure personalized attention and ample time on stable, easy-to-handle boats. blurb: Guests can rent boats, sailboats, and kayaks to explore the south shore waters, find fishing spots, sail, or anchor at sandy islands for a day of fun. The experience includes eco-tourism with up-close marine life viewing and educational opportunities. After boating, guests can enjoy fresh coastal fare at Lily’s Seaside waterfront dining.
